newsitem.title: FINLAND: HARTWALL SEES BIG RISE IN BBH 1997 SALES.
newsitem.headline: HARTWALL SEES BIG RISE IN BBH 1997 SALES.

text.p: Finnish beverages maker Oy Hartwall Ab said on Thursday it expected the sales volume of its Baltic Beverages Holding Ab (BBH) subsidiary to rise to over 500 million litres this year from some 320 million litres in 1996.
"We expect BBH's sales volume to reach some 520-530 million litres this year," Hartwall CEO Jussi Lansio told a news conference.
BBH is jointly owned by Hartwall and Pripps-Ringnes, part of Norwegian food group Orkla .
In January-April, BBH's sales rose over 94 percent on thre year-ago period to 134 million litres, Hartwall said.
The Hartwall group's total sales volume was 580 million litres in 1996.
